key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.07s): Initial archival pose of pillow; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=2.2s): Mid-sequence articulation of pillow; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=3.43s): Peak dynamic extension of pillow over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=4.67s): Follow-through and settle of pillow with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of pillow (1.07s..4.67s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
